services.desc: At this time, all classes are full for the Spring 2026 session of the School of the Arts, and registration has closed. The Spring 2026 session of the School of the Arts runs January 17 through May 9. The program is divided into two age groups, where students learn various acting, singing and dance techniques, culminating in a showcase the week of May 11 (date and time to be determined). Beginner/Intermediate Level classes for ages 8 to 12 meet on Saturdays from 9:00am to 10:30am. Intermediate/Advanced Level classes for ages 13 to 18 meet on Saturdays from 11:00am to 12:30pm.
